name: display-switcher
title: Display Switcher
description: Hand every shared monitor to the other Mac at once, over DDC/CI with m1ddc.
author: sujha

commands.name: toggle-displays
commands.title: Toggle Displays
commands.subtitle: Other Mac
commands.description: Switch every configured monitor to the other Mac's input (no UI).

preferences.name: inputs
preferences.title: Monitor Inputs
preferences.description: One entry per monitor, separated by ';'. Each entry: 'name=A/B', where name matches the monitor's name (from `m1ddc display list`) and A/B are the input codes of the two Macs. The same value works on both Macs. Common codes: DP 1: 15, DP 2: 16, HDMI 1: 17, HDMI 2: 18, USB-C: 27.

preferences.name: m1ddcPath
preferences.title: m1ddc Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the m1ddc executable. Leave empty for auto-detection.
